snippet.title: CoreRunner | First Look | indie.io
snippet.description:
Skate. Slash. Shoot. Leave deadly light trails in your wake.

Wishlist CoreRunner on Steam Today: 
https://store.steampowered.com/app/3415380/CoreRunner/

A high-speed skater shooter where momentum is your greatest weapon.

Imprisoned within the Core, players must fight their way out using light blades, guns, and deadly neon trails. Chain together skating, shooting, and sword strikes while leaving glowing light paths that destroy enemies behind you.

Break free from the Core in this Tron-inspired neon arcade action experience set to a pulsing synthwave soundtrack.
